entities.summary: Ivan Mihailov is a boxer from Bulgaria. He competed for Bulgaria in the 1968 Summer Olympics held in Mexico City, Mexico in the featherweight event where he finished in third place. Ivan Mihailov was a athletes & competitors from Sliven (b. 1944-12-25, Sliven). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
